svg.title: The centered prime sum, normalized
svg.desc: Computed: (G(y) - log 2pi)/sqrt(y) for 10 <= y <= 10^7, where G(y) = sum_{n<=y} Lambda(n)(y/n-1) - y log y + (1+gamma) y. Dotted lines: +-(2+gamma-log 4pi), the band that RH forces. Shaded column: one power window [Y, Y^(3/2)], Y = 10^4, with an illustrative one-sided ceiling C y^theta (theta = 0.55) in the same normalization.
